method.title: 泰语断行与阿语实际字形大小的抽帧观察
method.trigger: 该源泰语和阿语文字排版与短字幕取样时。
method.action: 检查实际词组断行、阿语墨迹大小与连写，并逐短实例检查实际中点。
method.failure_signature: 泰语按字符换行拆开词及元音组；全局固定抽样可能漏掉短分句。
limitations: 单源抽帧；本候选未独立打包修复前视觉对照。
无正常播放、个人听审及精确字幕配音同步验证。
Quoted observations do not prove causality or validate the proposed action; controller review required.
method.next_counterexample_test: 复核原始前后帧，并按每个短实例检查实际编码边界与正常播放。

record.hypothesis: On this source, Thai character-based wrapping split words and vowel groups; explicit phrase breaks produced readable whole-word lines in the reviewed final instance frames. Arabic nominal font size did not reliably express visible ink size; larger actual Arabic glyphs remained joined, RTL and unclipped in the reviewed title, dialogue and CTA frames. Inspect the actual midpoint of every short caption instance: a fixed global sampling schedule can miss a complete short second clause. These are same-source sampled observations, not continuous playback, native-speaker acceptance or cross-source causal proof. External full-audio and head/tail model reports are distinct from personal listening; the Arabic male-register difference remained disclosed rather than silently marked consistent.
